description: Count the signed-in user's EPCIS events, computed by the repository in one call, grouped by one dimension: eventType, bizStep, disposition, readPoint, bizLocation, action, day or month. Takes the same filters as query_events. Use it for "how many", "which steps", "per day" questions instead of paging through events; then query_events for the events behind a bucket.

bizLocation.description: Business Location, an SGLN Digital Link

bizStep.description: CBV bizStep, bare (shipping) or as URI

disposition.description: CBV disposition, bare (in_transit) or as URI

epc.description: an instance or class identifier anywhere in the event

eventType.description: ObjectEvent, AggregationEvent, TransformationEvent, AssociationEvent or TransactionEvent

from.description: events at or after this time, ISO 8601

groupBy.description: eventType, bizStep, disposition, readPoint, bizLocation, action, day or month

more.description: further EPCIS query parameters as a query string

readPoint.description: Read Point, an SGLN Digital Link

name: summarize
title: Summarize events
